verdict.rationale: Speechmatics' own docs say it offers SDKs for building against its APIs ("Integrate Speechmatics quickly with SDKs for your language"). That is a first-party capability, but the evidence is a single headline-level mention, so its depth is unproven. missing for 10: named SDK languages and package repositories, SDK reference documentation or code samples, evidence of SDK coverage across realtime, batch, Agent STT and TTS APIs, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
